description: Introduction and overview of the E-3 Sentry (AWACS): What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The E-3 Sentry is a four-engine airborne warning and control aircraft built by Boeing on the 707 airframe, entering service in 1977. Its rotating radar dome tracks air and surface contacts hundreds of miles away, directing fighters like a flying command post. 68 were built; NATO and several allies operate the type.
